title: Ordering food at a restaurant
listen_for: What does Maria order, and what changes her first choice?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Good evening! Do you have a reservation?

sentences.speaker: maria
sentences.text: Yes, a table for two under Maria Costa.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Perfect. Please follow me, and here are your menus.

sentences.speaker: maria
sentences.text: Thank you. Could I have a glass of water, please?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Of course. Are you ready to order, or would you like a few more minutes?

sentences.speaker: maria
sentences.text: I think I'm ready. I'd like the mushroom pasta, please.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: I'm very sorry, but we have just run out of mushrooms tonight.

sentences.speaker: maria
sentences.text: Oh, that's a shame. What would you recommend instead?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: The chicken with roasted vegetables is very popular, and the tomato pasta is lovely too.

sentences.speaker: maria
sentences.text: Is the chicken spicy? I don't really like spicy food.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Not at all. It comes with lemon and fresh herbs.

sentences.speaker: maria
sentences.text: That sounds good. I'll have the chicken, please, but without onions.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: No problem. Would you like anything else while you wait?

sentences.speaker: maria
sentences.text: Just some bread, please. My friend is running a few minutes late.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: I'll bring it right away. Your food will take about fifteen minutes.

sentences.speaker: maria
sentences.text: That's fine. We're not in a hurry.

exercise.prompt: Why can't Maria have the mushroom pasta?

options.text: The pasta is too spicy for her.
The restaurant has run out of mushrooms.
The kitchen is too busy to cook it.
Her friend does not want to share it.

key.explanation: Sam says they have just run out of mushrooms tonight, so Maria chooses the chicken instead.

spoken.prompt: In your own words, what does Maria order, and why does she change her first choice?

points.text: Maria first wanted the mushroom pasta
The restaurant had run out of mushrooms
She ordered the chicken instead, without onions

fill_blank.prompt: Complete what Sam says about the chicken: “It comes with lemon and fresh ___.”

fill_key.explanation: Sam says the chicken comes with lemon and fresh herbs.

sequencing.prompt: Put these moments from the dinner in the order they happened.

items.text: Maria chooses the chicken without onions
Maria asks for a glass of water
Sam says they have run out of mushrooms

sequence_key.explanation: First the water, then the news about the mushrooms, then the chicken, and the bread last.
